reconciling.measures: undispatched reservation re-admitted on a limit cut (ledger stays within the new limit)
a pre-cut in-flight commit over the new limit is FLAGGED as an overrun, not silently accepted
lost ack with no committed effect: reservation released, a fresh retry denied against the reduced limit
definition digest drift, enforced: operation held for reauthorization, never committed
definition digest drift, recorded-not-enforced: operation commits but the attempt is flagged mismatched
a transport resend of a known operation_id is idempotent (allowed, no second consumption; books match the ledger)
a limit cut below already-committed consumption flags an overrun on the grant
revocation releases the not-yet-dispatched; nothing new commits; a prior commit is not retro-flagged
